title: Anti-freeze gating — prevent UI thread blocking under pressure
description: Heavy deferred work (evolution snapshot, dev packet, autonomy dock) is gated under HIGH/CRITICAL resource pressure so the UI thread stays responsive. Per-frame budget accounting ensures each update cycle stays within 50ms (25ms under pressure).
resume_hint: Per-frame budget accounting implemented. BackgroundResourceMonitor integration done via _should_defer_heavy_work pressure halving.
next_action: Verify on live Windows that frame budget traces appear in runtime_audit.jsonl and no UI stalls > 50ms.

metadata.coverage_detail: _should_defer_heavy_work() gate using _assess_resource_pressure(). Fixed IssueSeverity comparison bug (str(IssueSeverity.HIGH) returns 'IssueSeverity.HIGH' not 'high'). Gate applied in both _apply_task_result and _apply_task_failure.
metadata.p01_additions: Stub tests for _should_defer_heavy_work extracted to lightweight suite (no AppBootstrap).
metadata.p02_additions: No direct changes — antifreeze gating is orthogonal to dispatch lifecycle tracing. Pressure-gated methods (_update_evolution_snapshot etc.) are correctly skipped under load.
metadata.p012_additions: PR #390 adds process-relative recent-stall detection, post-external-consultation dock refresh cooldown, budget cooldown after slow dock refresh, and enriched freeze reports with runtime audit context.

p013_additions.root_cause_evidence: Live freeze reports showed ui_event_loop_stall with stack in bootstrap._on_window_lifecycle -> startup_timeline.mark -> logger.info, plus repeated window_activeChanged events and RSS spikes.
guards_added: startup_timeline logger.info rate limit for window_* phases
secret/API-key browser open suppression unless user-confirmed

p016_additions.root_cause_evidence: A new live freeze happened after an external timeout, not during startup/window lifecycle. The next follow-up message triggered local chat inference instead of cheap causal reconstruction from the previous failure payload.
guards_added: external failure follow-up short-circuit before heavy chat inference
dock skip telemetry rate limit per reason
remaining_root_algorithm_work: process-isolated local inference if Python threads continue starving Qt
closed_root_algorithm_work: central reasoning budget gate before every heavy inference path — _should_defer_reasoning() implemented
OSES finding for repeated follow-up-after-failure freezes — _reasoning_budget_findings() implemented

implementation: _should_defer_reasoning() gates heavy inference when under pressure + recent slow inference
_record_heavy_inference_timing() records elapsed time for budget gate
Wired into sendChat before heavy local inference path
reasoning_budget_gate_slice.tests: 7 reasoning budget + 5 OSES findings tests in test_antifreeze_visual_metacognition.py

implementation: _should_skip_remaining_heavy_work() gates individual heavy ops within a frame
Wired into _apply_task_result and _apply_task_failure with per-op checks
frame_budget_slice.tests: 6 frame budget + 3 OSES findings tests in test_antifreeze_visual_metacognition.py
